request.style: English, rootsy Americana folk, earthy male vocal, acoustic guitar, banjo, harmonica, upright bass, foot stomps, plain and wise, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A sower went out to sow his seed in the morning sun
He scattered it with open hands and didn't miss a one
Some fell along the hard-packed path where people come and go
The birds came down and ate it up before it had a chance to grow

[Chorus]
Listen, listen, whoever has ears
Let him hear the word that the sower brings
Some fell here and some fell there
But the good soil bears a hundredfold

[Verse]
Some fell on the rocky ground with little soil to keep
It sprang up quick and green and proud, but the roots were never deep
When the sun rose it was scorched and withered in the heat
Like a heart that takes the word with joy but falls when trouble meets

[Verse]
Some fell in among the thorns that grew up thick and tall
The worries of this life came in and choked it, leaf and all
And the deceitfulness of wealth wound round it like a chain
It grew but never bore a fruit, it never filled with grain

[Chorus]
Listen, listen, whoever has ears
Let him hear the word that the sower brings
Some fell here and some fell there
But the good soil bears a hundredfold

[Verse]
But other seed fell on good soil, in the soft and open ground
It heard the word and understood, and the roots went deep and down
It bore a crop of thirtyfold and sixty in the field
And a hundredfold of harvest from the little seed it held

[Outro]
Some fell here and some fell there
But the good soil bears a hundredfold
Whoever has ears, let him hear
